MATERIAL VERIFICATION | | A1 | Primer product approved: Type, grade, batch verified against specification; test cert available
Acceptance: Product cert available; batch within shelf-life; coverage rate verified from label | Cl. 302 — Material approval | | | A2 | Primer quality verified: Viscosity, adhesion, coverage rate per IS standard; storage conditions OK
Acceptance: Product undiluted (if specified); no lumps/sediment; color uniform; ready for use | Cl. 302 — Quality check | | | B. APPLICATION PREPARATION | | B1 | Surface preparation complete: Surface clean, dry, defects filled, ready for primer
Acceptance: Surface prep sign-off available; moisture <10%; visual inspection confirms ready state | Cl. 302 — Prerequisite check | | | B2 | Weather conditions suitable: Ambient 10-35°C, humidity <85%, no rain forecast in next 24 hrs
Acceptance: Temperature logged; humidity confirmed; dry application conditions; rain protection available | Cl. 302 — Environmental conditions | | | B3 | Equipment ready: Brushes, rollers, trays clean; application tools in good condition
Acceptance: Tools clean, dry; bristles intact; roller nap 6-8mm for primer; no old paint residue | Cl. 302 — Tool readiness | | | C. PRIMER APPLICATION | | C1 | Coverage rate verified: Primer coverage rate per label (typically 8-12 m²/liter); area×rate=quantity
Acceptance: Coverage rate documented; quantity per m² calculated; actual consumption logged | Cl. 302 — Material control | | | C2 | Primer applied uniformly: Full coverage, no thin spots, no missed areas; consistent color across surface
Acceptance: Visual inspection shows uniform color; straightedge test shows no bare spots; 100% coverage | Cl. 302 — Application control | | | C3 | Application thickness: Wet thickness 80-120 microns typical; dry film thickness 20-40 microns
Acceptance: Wet thickness measured immediately; DFT checked after drying per spec | Cl. 302 — Thickness control | | | C4 | Edges and corners adequately filled; no thick runs or sags; application technique adequate
